blurb: Guests can enjoy a variety of handcrafted house beers brewed on-site, including seasonal, year-round, and small batch brews. The food menu features farm-sourced ingredients with options like bar snacks, soups, salads, mains, and a kids menu. The brewery emphasizes a welcoming atmosphere for family, friends, and travelers, with a focus on good drinks, great meals, and conversation.
